market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely range-bound with elevated volatility. Oil above $95 supports energy but pressures consumer. Fed holds in September per Waller but hike odds rising post-jobs data. Tech rallies on yield dips but Lululemon-type misses create pockets of weakness. Expect 2-3% sector rotation within S&P 500.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally bullish for infrastructure (HPE, Oracle, PANW). Energy premium persists through 2026-27 given Iran/Venezuela dynamics. Consumer bifurcation continues: experiential > goods. Rate environment stays restrictive through Q1 2027. Chinese AI cost advantage may reshape global tech competitive landscape by 2027.
